exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
TOLAC with at least one previous vaginal delivery
TOLAC with no previous vaginal delivery
trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: 781 women undergoing TOLAC at a single, academic, tertiary medical center
finding: Women undergoing TOLAC without prior vaginal delivery experienced longer labors than those with previous vaginal deliveries, and epidural analgesia was associated with longer first and second stages of labor in both groups.
mod_finding: This study found that women undergoing a trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) had longer labors than those with a previous vaginal delivery, and epidural analgesia use was associated with longer labors in both groups.
